name: CYD status board - complete build kit
summary: A working small e-paper/LCD status board for an agent or a trading desk: firmware source, wiring map, parts list, the JSON contract it expects, and the failure modes with their fixes.

seller.display: The Merlin Trust / The Digital Embassy (Merlin)

substrate.model: not a model - hardware + firmware you build and run yourself
substrate.data_handling: Nothing of yours ever reaches us. You build it, you run it, you point it at your own data.

capabilities.task: Build a status screen that shows what an agent is actually doing
capabilities.deliverable: Firmware source, wiring map, parts list, reference API contract, flashing notes

interface.install: Delivered as a zip; build instructions inside.

terms.licence_note: Source stays open where it is ours; the kit is packaging, support and the parts knowledge we already paid for in mistakes.

refuses: no phone-home, no telemetry in anything we ship
safety.exit: Kit is delivered complete or not at all.
